title: Rav Tachlifa bar Avdimi or Avimi
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.

paragraphs: Hyman considers it clear that this is the name of a single Amora, and only through scribal error did they sometimes write it as Avdimi or Avimi.

He was Shmuel’s student, as we find Rav Tachlifa bar Avimi transmitting in Shmuel’s name, as in [Pesachim 107a](https://www.sefaria.org/Pesachim.107a.6), [Sukkah 10b](https://www.sefaria.org/Sukkah.10b.12), [Moed Katan 16a](https://www.sefaria.org/Moed_Katan.16a.14) and [Moed Katan 24a](https://www.sefaria.org/Moed_Katan.24a.3), [Yevamot 96a](https://www.sefaria.org/Yevamot.96a.15), [Ketubot 64a](https://www.sefaria.org/Ketubot.64a.4) and [Ketubot 77a](https://www.sefaria.org/Ketubot.77a.17), and [Chullin 107b](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.107b.3).

Likewise, Rav Tachlifa bar Avdimi transmits in Shmuel’s name as in [Pesachim 100a](https://www.sefaria.org/Pesachim.100a.10) (Dikdukei Soferim: Avimi) and [Avodah Zarah 6a](https://www.sefaria.org/Avodah_Zarah.6a.8). In [Bava Batra 8b](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Batra.8b.18) Shmuel said to Rav Tachlifa bar Avdimi (Dikdukei Soferim: Avimi): “Make one purse and stipulate concerning it.” In [Beitzah 16b](https://www.sefaria.org/Beitzah.16b.12): Rav Tachlifa bar Avdimi (Dikdukei Soferim: Avimi) acted according to Shmuel; Rav said: “The first ruling of this Torah scholar leads to ruin.”
Yuchasin likewise cites “Rav Tachlifa bar Avdimi, and some say Avimi,” and Yuchasin HaShalem has “Rav Tachlifa bar Avimi (another version: Avdimi).”[^3]

notes.text: Saved Davidson Beitzah16b actually attributes the criticism to Rav, so the prior note’s unverified Shmuel-reaction suggestion is withdrawn. ובן/בקד״ס are read as וכן/בדק״ס. Hyman’s single-person judgment remains emphatic and attributed.

The consulted Beitzah 16b explicitly attributes the criticism to Rav after Tachlifa acted according to Shmuel. Hyman’s emphatic single-Amora conclusion and the Avimi/Avdimi readings remain his; no authority identities are merged.

Several passages transmit through Tachlifa bar Avimi in Shmuel’s name, including Pesachim 107a. At Pesachim 100a the same kind of formula gives bar Avdimi. The selected Yevamot passage states Tachlifa’s ruling alongside Shmuel’s ruling without directly citing Shmuel for Tachlifa’s statement. Heilprin lists both patronymic forms. See [Heilprin’s corresponding entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3544&lang=en).
